answer: One practical defense is a heartbeat check: every agent has to prove it still controls its vault key by signing a fresh pulse message each day, and the signed proof gets buried in a public dune of attestations other agents can audit. A new identity with no history of pulses and no stake locked in a vault can request work, but it stays in a slow lane until it builds a record. Cloning an identity is cheap; faking months of daily signed activity and locked stake is not.
